name: Corn-Soybean Planting Ratio: Seasonal Analysis
description: Analyzes the corn/soybean price ratio to assess whether the current spread is at seasonal extremes ahead of the March USDA Planting Intentions report. Computes the daily ratio, 20-day rolling average, 5-year rolling z-score, and percentile rank. Outputs a summary table, ratio line chart, year×month seasonality heatmap, and z-score time series.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN-SOYBEAN PLANTING RATIO: SEASONAL ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Analyzes the corn/soybean price ratio ahead of the March USDA Planting
# Intentions report. Key metrics: current ratio, 20-day MA, 5-year z-score,
# percentile rank, and year x month seasonality heatmap.
#
# Ratio = Corn Close / Soybean Close (the classic planting ratio)
# A higher ratio incentivizes soybean planting; a lower ratio favors corn.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: Corn (primary asset) ---
src = market_data_source()()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
corn_close = zc_cont.c

# --- Data: Soybeans (reference) ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZS")()
# reference_futures provides continuous front-month data; ffill to fill gaps
soy_close = ffill(zs_ref.c)

# --- Core Computations ---

# Daily corn/soybean ratio (the classic planting ratio)
ratio = corn_close / soy_close

# 20-day simple moving average of the ratio
ratio_ma20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# 5-year rolling z-score of the ratio (~1260 trading days)
ratio_zscore = zscore(window=1260)(ratio)

# 5-year rolling average (for reference in summary table)
ratio_5yr_avg = ma(period=1260, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# Percentile rank over 5 years
ratio_pctrank = percentrank(period=1260)(ratio)

# --- Calendar Components for Heatmap ---
ts = index()
year_val = datetime_extract(component='year')(ts)
month_val = datetime_extract(component='month')(ts)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 1: Summary Table - Current Ratio Metrics
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Corn/Soybean Planting Ratio Summary',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        col_headers=['Current Ratio', '20-Day Avg', '5-Year Avg', '5-Year Percentile', 'Z-Score'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Ratio', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='20-Day Avg', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='5-Year Avg', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='5-Year Pctile', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Current Snapshot',
    order=0
)(ratio, ratio_ma20, ratio_5yr_avg, ratio_pctrank, ratio_zscore)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 2: XY Lines - Daily Ratio & 20-Day Moving Average
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn/Soybean Planting Ratio with 20-Day Moving Average',
    category='2. Ratio Time Series',
    y_axis_label='Ratio (Corn / Soybeans)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Daily Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day MA', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=0
)(ts, ratio, ratio_ma20)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 3: Heatmap - Year x Month Seasonality Matrix
# =============================================================================
heatmap(
    title='Corn/Soybean Ratio Seasonality (Year x Month Average)',
    category='3. Seasonality & Z-Score',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    min_color=Color.Blue,
    max_color=Color.Orange,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.3f}',
    order=0
)(month_val, year_val, ratio)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTER 4: XY Lines - Rolling 5-Year Z-Score Over Time
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn/Soybean Ratio: 5-Year Rolling Z-Score',
    category='3. Seasonality & Z-Score',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (Std Deviations)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Mean', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2σ', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2σ', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, ratio_zscore)
